svg.title: Atlas — cosmic web v8
svg.desc: A densely textured cosmic-web map. Dark purple-magenta background. Matter density is rendered as overlapping chains of rotated elliptical clumps (not lines), forming irregular filaments in many directions — vertical, diagonal NW-SE, NE-SW, and others — interconnecting into a polygonal web. Inter-halo filaments are visible as denser, brighter chains of clumps connecting project halos. Each halo has a soft outer haze blending into the cosmic web texture, with a sharp interior glyph (hexagonal DAG with lensing arcs at the Thesis core; stacked CNN layers, wavelet quadtree, transport plan, posterior contours, MLP, sheared galaxy ellipses on a survey patch for Euclid HOWLS; the UVa Rotunda; classroom seating for AstroStat; and so on).
